description: Re-anchored for the reject-disposition + exclude_labels spec change (v0.11.0): spec.md additively documents the deterministic reject disposition (REJECTED_LABEL / REJECT_MARKER / reject_dispositions / gh_issue_reject_sink — comment + label, never close), the triager stamping an authoritative target_feature, and the PULL exclude_labels negative term; contract.md additively declares that public surface plus the gh issue comment / gh issue edit invocations. This is legitimate new behaviour (mirrors the apply_labels precedent), not re-bloat. This baseline records the post-v0.11.0 doc line counts plus a one-line margin, so the housekeep gate continues as a re-bloat regression guard (current docs must stay STRICTLY smaller than this) while the load-bearing-token + cleanup gates remain intact.
